**Denver, CO, Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Palisade Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: PALI) (“Palisade” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation prodrugs for patients living with inflammatory and fibrotic diseases, today announced that JD Finley, Chief Executive Officer, and Mitchell Jones, M.D., Ph.D., President and Chief Medical Officer, will participate in the Stifel 2026 Virtual Immunology and Inflammation Forum.


**Date:** September 23, 2026
**Time:** 1:00 PM – 1:25 PM ET
**Presenters:** JD Finley, Chief Executive Officer; Mitchell Jones, President & Chief Medical Officer
**Format:** Virtual


The presentation will provide an update on the Company’s PALI-2108 clinical development program, including recent progress across ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease, the expanding clinical and translational data supporting PALI-2108’s differentiated profile, and upcoming development milestones.


A live[webcast](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kik5t8MGVjBrAQF9JXo9Q1TMTurSP9hlfwYzc17QtBPgw5CZqvI6YxSdaagpdQgi9cgEQgJY5dhmH9LzdsvE9rUh_EkiJi9clPxBMEAcCHjYOYj56QMCWoureZaXDNfZFGK3K5jT_7F0z1khJ9z3UhhfhECKosAcgzMdhTmixowbAsQHeM5_7cDen_u1gsjlPUgwxGg4sezX9WHDiYt2kmYUwgXfYw7MSWCtaIAzlxTHGd8VJpgHaBd5Cm8DaFkdO9ZkEJxCBssfQX7-Pj1iCD1S9LOKPhgFxgHxROn6JMbHTzkgYgX30zjRT9k6C2LwanWieAR851jspmw3iGTjuTYu7mZF4DR2h0l8w0cAvdvgZvlzzQhoeICjrCCsIxwK_FAheGhCGdtcBU9lU83RRZnLK0oWCbMXBrI6bDzC15RPsETwOIRyyMegcF7ZjiUk) of the presentation will be accessible on the[Events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mW23ikbgrPYnYu7nGmndkkjCW3NkQ654gQniQrYU4zV-wF8B_e17E-AMSG4_I7XqrRhvXe1aXfm6dS02a8REdVBo8nkrLxGxA2ybzMoeGXpbIsY-sfE2f7E14Vow30WT) page in the[Investors](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AlZcKWQRLCsOw4cTsHkq2BIMIIJGmpPAl682ZQtdVFYSm9anpSXdj77ubV6xr71AxazAYSPB0oRJXBbOUCzL1A==) section of the Company’s website at[palisadebio.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V2LiY4EUkc-SUXJZEHxcjhbHB8h1cLZgxSsJAU3_a3SITlutjC_FMERMrPPrQcxvLP73VYqGU6V3Om8a_GqzpA_RTAobDFW4dPN7NL1NKw0=) . A replay will be available following the live event and will be archived for a limited time.


In addition to the presentation, management will be available to participate in one-on-one meetings with qualified members of the investor community who are registered for the conference.


**About Palisade Bio**


Palisade Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: PALI) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing prodrugs for patients living with inflammatory and fibrotic diseases.
